summary: The recorded base reproduces the exact TP-shard interleaving corruption. The exact candidate preserves model-specific sharded proxy entries and retains all-gather reconstruction for established replicated keys in both ordinary and paired scheduler transport paths.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: both receivers obtained [1,1,1,1,2,2,2,2] rather than their TP-corresponding sender payload; replicated control passed.
Passing-after through actual GroupCoordinator one-way send/receive: each TP rank retained its distinct full tensor and replicated data remained correct.
Candidate regression and surrounding unit suite: 7 passed.
Independent paired send_recv_tensor_dict boundary case on all four ranks: custom TP shard, replicated hidden_states, and non-tensor metadata all preserved.
Candidate source on AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 selected 4 elements for replicated hidden_states and all 8 for a sharded custom key.
Only candidate raw log artifacts had trailing whitespace/newline-at-EOF diagnostics; modified source and test files were not identified.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, ROCm 7.2. GPU tensors exercised actual candidate send-side selection; no multi-GPU collective was possible.

remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned, so tp=2 x pp=2 transport was validated with four Gloo CPU processes, not RCCL/NCCL across four GPUs.
No RWKV-7 weights/model integration was available; semantic accuracy and greedy decoding were not tested.
The candidate low-level API relies on matching sender/receiver allowlists, though all scheduler call sites were verified to pass the same constant.
No native code changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
Candidate raw evidence logs contain whitespace diagnostics under git diff --check.
